You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(1, 10)
               if any(all(v == c for v in row) for row in grid)
               and any(all(grid[r][col] == c for r in range(h)) for col in range(w)))
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    panel_h, panel_w = sep_rows[0], sep_cols[0]
    # The first panel of the first band contains a small 2x2 color key and
    # the larger motif to copy into every panel, recolored per horizontal band.
    first = [grid[r][c] for r in range(panel_h) for c in range(panel_w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep)]
    counts = Counter(first)
    key_color = min((c for c, n in counts.items() if n == 4), default=None)
    motif_color = max((c for c in counts if c != key_color), key=lambda c: counts[c])
    motif = [(r, c) for r in range(panel_h) for c in range(panel_w)
             if grid[r][c] == motif_color]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs in row_starts:
        key = next((grid[rs+r][c] for r in range(panel_h) for c in range(panel_w)
                    if grid[rs+r][c] not in (0, sep)), 0)
        for cs in col_starts:
            for r, c in motif:
                out[rs+r][cs+c] = key
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
